title: Grant Funding Profiles | Funding | CDC
content: September 4, 2024 Grant Funding Profiles Key points The CDC Grant Funding Profiles site has state-and-territory-specific grants funding profiles starting with fiscal year 2010. CDC Grant Funding Profiles site The CDC Grant Funding Profiles site offers quick access to information on CDC funding provided to recipients in states and territories to address issues of public health importance. This includes funding provided to state and local health departments, universities, and other public and private agencies for a variety of public health programs.
